name: Cementos Molins, S.A.
summary: Cementos Molins, S.A. manufactures and markets materials and solutions for construction. It engages in the exploitation of quarries and clay deposits, limestones and gypsum, and related products. It offers cements; concrete and aggregates; precast solutions; construction solutions; urban landscape and circular economy. The company operates in Mexico, Argentina, Uruguay, Bolivia, Colombia, Bangladesh, India, Tunisia, Croatia, Turkey, Spain, the United States and Asia. The company was incorporated in 1928 and is based in Barcelona, Spain.
